scope: Authored analysis and metadata. Field production and bounded reference searches; no silicon pixel semantics.

relations.name: Mask semantics
relations.proven: 0x11 tests bits0 and4, not bit1. Packers independently insert low source bits with ARM BFI. Edge first three bytes also carry bits1/2 which the aggregate ignores.
relations.unknown: No independent field name proves bypass, clock-gating or exact hardware operation order.

relations.name: Mode selection
relations.proven: Ordinary selector path uses tuning-object u16+0x204 values2/3 to choose edge getter5313fd80/5313fdac, otherwise5313fd54. Its u8+0x1f6 internal CustomImage enum10 selects ColorReference getter53140104 instead of531400e4. Coordinate getter531401e4 is project-only in this branch; other runtime branches differ.
relations.unknown: No one-to-one eight-byte control signature per user CustomImage mode is established; runtime sub-index and all alternate branches not exhaustively catalogued.

relations.name: CPU preparation evidence
relations.proven: Edge resource descriptor byte0 ==1 gates coefficient/table preparation in5313399c, alongside P.byte5d and cached-state conditions. This supports a functional enable role in CPU preparation, not physical hardware bypass/order.
relations.unknown: No ordering constraint between WB, matrix, tone and gamma pixels follows from this bit or CPU dispatch order.
